questions.topic: PrepLadder · 10.National Immunization Schedule, Delayed immunization, Cold chain
questions.stem: Which of the following storage practices is appropriately matched with the corresponding cold chain level? Level Storage practice A. Subcenter Use walk-in cold rooms to store large quantities of vaccines. B. Primary Health Center Use small ice-lined refrigerators to store vaccines for up to one month. C. Community Health Center Store vaccines in vaccine carriers for daily use. D. State Level Use domestic refrigerators due to their large storage capacity.
